briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 training run hits 10^27 FLOPs as US tightens export controls on advanced chips

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs pushing training runs beyond 10^27 FLOPs. Geopolitical tensions between the US and China are driving new export controls while safety concerns mount around agentic systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's Orion-2 shows early signs of long-horizon planning. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3 Ultra are in final training, while xAI's Grok-3 achieved new reasoning benchmarks on internal evals.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement actions target agentic systems while red-teaming reports highlight persistent jailbreak vectors in multimodal models.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA H200 shipments reached 1.2M units this quarter. Microsoft and Oracle announced joint 200MW AI data center expansions in Texas and Arizona amid ongoing power grid constraints.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first system to reach 95% on the GAIA benchmark trigger immediate export controls or international treaties?
